specification.patient_selection: Among matched cell lines, retain lexicographically smallest ModelID per known patient in primary analysis. Missing/Unknown/NA patient IDs receive unique cell-specific identifiers, never one shared missing-patient cluster.
specification.coverage_design_note: Sanger protein header audit finds no ACTB or BICRA. Primary background is the six prespecified broad-BAF background genes with exact symbol measurements; it is not a geometry-controlled within-cBAF noncontact panel. The ACTB+ACTL6A physical contrast must be reported non-evaluable if ACTB is absent; ACTL6A-only is descriptive sensitivity. No association results were used to make this feasibility decision.
specification.primary_adjustment: Each protein is regressed on its own RNA, own gene-level CNV, and available predeclared sample covariates. Spearman correlation of residuals. Cell-line covariate is lineage; CPTAC covariates are documented purity/batch when available, with a base RNA/CNV-only analysis reported separately.
specification.sensitivity_adjustment: Both proteins are regressed on the common set of the anchor and partner RNA/CNV and the same sample covariates.
specification.resampling: Shared lineage-stratified cell-line row indices for all genes and modalities, retaining repeated draws, refitting both regressions per pair per draw. One cell line per source patient in the inferential primary cell-line panel; retain additional same-patient lines only for descriptive sensitivity. CPTAC one tumor per patient per cohort; same cohort row draws shared across all genes.
specification.p_value: Two-sided centered bootstrap approximation: (1+count(abs(T_boot-T_obs)>=abs(T_obs)))/(1+B_valid). Report percentile confidence intervals separately; not an exact test.
specification.multiplicity: BH across the two primary tests within discovery. External replication: BH across two tests times available predeclared cancer cohorts, not selecting the more favorable cohort/model. Sensitivity analyses report estimates and intervals without creating alternative primary positives.
specification.epigenomic_primary: GSE101966 interaction (ARID1A_KO+ARID1B_KD minus ARID1A_KO) minus (ARID1B_KD minus WT). Genome-wide BH. Public FPKM-only limma is explicitly exploratory. Two independent infections per group, not two independent ARID1A-KO clones. Module expression does not imply module dependency.
specification.interpretation: Fixed-panel conditional association and cross-cohort replication, not proof of protein degradation, complex assembly, cBAF-specific synthetic lethality, or patient treatment benefit. Retain corrected-null findings. No new deep-learning model unless prespecified molecular analyses establish a data-supported need.

leave_one_lineage_out.inference: Point estimates only; no confidence intervals or p-values

layer_df_note: Raw layers have no nuisance-model residual df; own/joint df are assessed separately.
numerical_revision: v3: unique-design prediction and exact-zero centering of constant strata preserve mathematical ties; no rounding, model changes, or result-selected thresholds
inference_scope: Fixed assayed BAF panel; not an isolated physical-contact effect or protein stability proof
external_multiplicity_note: For clinical replication, collect both primary tests from LUAD and LUSC and apply BH across the four planned tests.
